remarks: *Note, monthly rent is $1,500 and all utilities are $500/month extra (total $2,000/month). Accessory Apartment for rent! Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this charming 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom accessory apartment, nestled in the serene neighborhood of North Stamford. This inviting space is an ideal retreat for those seeking a peaceful living environment with the convenience of city access. The apartment boasts a private entrance on the back deck, fresh paint, and new carpets. Designed with simplicity and functionality in mind, this cozy apartment features a well-appointed kitchen, a comfortable living area, and a spacious bedroom, making it perfect for individuals or couples. The inclusion of all utilities adds an extra layer of convenience, allowing you to enjoy a hassle-free living experience. (The owners will provide AC units for summer months and cooling seasons). There is no laundry on site. The property includes one assigned parking space. Prospective tenants will be subject to a lease agreement, credit check, and background/reference check. property is managed off-site. The owner is willing to negotiate all terms.
